sections.title: Kansas City Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Kansas City's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Healthcare Technology (Oracle Health / Cerner)
paragraphs: Cerner Corporation (now Oracle Health following Oracle's $28B acquisition) headquartered in North Kansas City — the world's second-largest health IT company. Oracle Health's Kansas City operations:
Clinical informatics AI for Oracle Health's Millennium EHR platform and the health system customers using Cerner technology.
Healthcare data analytics for the large Oracle Health analytics and population health customer base.
AI feature development advisory for Oracle Health's product teams building next-generation clinical AI.

Major KC health systems: University of Kansas Health System (Lawrence KS), Children's Mercy Hospital (Kansas City, one of the US's top children's hospitals), Saint Luke's Health System (Kansas City), and AdventHealth (Shawnee Mission). HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Kansas City's academic and community health systems.
Cost: $40,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks | HIPAA, Oracle Health context

blocks.heading: Agriculture and Commodity Analytics
paragraphs: Kansas City is the US's agricultural heartland financial and commercial center — the Kansas City Board of Trade (KCBT, now CME Group Kansas City), the USDA's National Agricultural Statistics Service's KC regional office, and the large grain and livestock trading companies:

Commodity price analytics: ML for grain (winter wheat, corn, soybeans) and livestock (cattle, hogs) price prediction incorporating USDA crop and livestock reports, weather analytics, and export demand for Kansas City's large commodity trading community.

Beef and pork processing AI: Production optimization and quality analytics for the large beef and pork processing plants surrounding Kansas City — the area's food processing industry includes some of the world's largest cattle processing facilities.

Precision agriculture for Great Plains crops: Irrigation optimization, yield prediction, and input application analytics for the wheat, corn, and soybean farms that the Great Plains agricultural community anchors.
Cost: $25,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–20 weeks | USDA context

blocks.heading: Logistics (Kansas City's Rail Hub)
paragraphs: Kansas City is one of the US's most important rail hubs — every major Class I railroad intersects here:

Intermodal operations analytics: ML for Kansas City's large intermodal facilities — container tracking, chassis management, and rail-truck transfer optimization for the major intermodal terminals at Argentine (BNSF) and Armourdale (UP) yards.
Trucking operations: ML for YRC Worldwide (Overland Park) and the large LTL trucking operations concentrated in Kansas City's logistics community.
Cross-border trade analytics: ML for Kansas City's US-Mexico cross-border logistics flows — a significant Kansas City freight corridor given the city's central position in the USMCA trade geography.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Consumer Technology (Garmin)
paragraphs: Garmin (Olathe KS HQ, adjacent Kansas City) — the world's largest GPS device company:
Navigation analytics and map update intelligence for Garmin's consumer navigation products.
Wearables health analytics for Garmin's growing Connect platform and fitness wearable community.
Aviation analytics for Garmin's large aviation electronics business.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | CCPA, health data context
